newsitem.title: POLAND: Vereinsbank boosts capital of Polish unit.
newsitem.headline: Vereinsbank boosts capital of Polish unit.

text.p: Germany's Bayerische Vereinsbank AG increased share capital of its fully-owned Polish subsidiary Vereinsbank Polska SA to 185 million zlotys from 75 million, the bank said on Thursday.

"Increase in capital shows Vereinsbank wants to widen activities of Vereinsbank Polska SA, which now will be one of the biggest foreign banks operating in Poland in terms of capital," Vereinsbank Polska said in a statement.
The bank started Polish operations in September 1996 with 44 employees and focuses primarily on large companies operating in Poland. @
Bayerische won a full Polish banking licence late in 1995 after it agreed to take over a failed small Megabank.
